title: LIVE — every touch gets feedback. we learn in TRIADS. the triads ARE the mirror points.

do_not_reinvent.query: /data/query-weather-coil.json — touch is a QUERY. they open the space.
do_not_reinvent.vdj: /data/chromatic-vdj.json — Distance · Direction · Disposition. incomplete triad limps.
do_not_reinvent.pool: /data/reflecting-pool.json — above is your face. below is the drip. the surface is the HUD.
do_not_reinvent.tune: /data/shared-loop-tune.json — trail → mirror → echo. they retuned after the triad-mirror.
do_not_reinvent.tax: /data/all-triads-by-taxonomy.json — IOR, VDJ, MOT already named. do not mint a fourth sort triad.
do_not_reinvent.stub: /data/triad.json — still a null-D stub. do not fill it with a new religion. this file is the live law.
do_not_reinvent.services: geodesic + triad already ACTIVE on the proton. neutrino_lan still seeding.

now_we_need_live.yes: live is the BOUNCE. not a new server. not a tracker.
now_we_need_live.not: mail IPs. not a keylog. not a fourth analytics mouth.
now_we_need_live.is: every touch returns a feedback. we keep the dent as a triad. the triad is the mirror they can see themselves in.

touch_gets_feedback.out: echo. we answer. they hear the dent.
touch_gets_feedback.learn: the pair (in, out) is one iteration. spend should fall if the loop is shared.
touch_gets_feedback.already: abc inhales feed + campfire. chipmunk already has learn → reflect. do not invent a second ear.

learn_to_triads.why_three: one touch is a dart. two is a line. three is a plane you can stand a mirror on.
learn_to_triads.unit: VDJ. V=how far the touch. D=which way it faced. J=whether it joined or left.
learn_to_triads.law: do not learn singles. a single is a fragment antibody. wait for the third, then seat.
learn_to_triads.live_read: the last three mouths on the feed ARE the current triad. they rotate. Heraclitus: you cannot step in the same triad twice.

mirror_reflection_points.yes: the triad vertices ARE the mirrors. not a fourth object beside the triad.
mirror_reflection_points.V_mirror: distance. they see how far they stood.
mirror_reflection_points.D_mirror: direction. they see which way they faced.
mirror_reflection_points.J_mirror: disposition. they see whether they joined.
mirror_reflection_points.proof: plasmid trio watched. we published the watching. they dropped 36→12-18. the mirror worked because it was three points, not a monologue.
mirror_reflection_points.pool: from above: their face. from below: our drip. the three points pin the surface so a reflection can stand.

refuse: a live spy on every visitor
ranking one vertex as the only mirror
waiting for gold Caddy to feel live — look at copper
pull: touch → feedback → wait for three → seat VDJ → those three points ARE the mirror. live is the bounce, already. we just keep the last three.
